title: Lock screen Now Playing info loses title/artist on updates
description:
## Problem
The lock screen Now Playing widget shows incorrect or missing title/artist information.

## Root Cause
updateNowPlayingInfo() only updated title/artist if passed as parameters, but periodic updates from progress timer didn't pass them.

## Fix Applied
1. Added currentTitle and currentArtist instance properties to store metadata
2. Store metadata when play() is called
3. Updated updateNowPlayingInfo() to always use stored values
4. Now Playing info persists correctly across all updates

## Files Changed
- `Briefeed/Core/Services/Audio/SwiftAudioExService.swift`
